relationships.subject: CGRP inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: Patients' average headache days per month was reduced from 27.6 ± 4.8 initially to 18.6 ± 9.4 post-treatment (p = 0.00651), and their average pain level was reduced from 8.4 ± 1.4 out of 10 to 5.4 ± 2.5 (p = 0.00074).

key_findings: Adding CGRP inhibitors to onabotulinumtoxinA reduced headache days (27.6 to 18.6/month) in 17 patients with no serious adverse effects.
